# Calculate correlation between motif counts across wheat homologs
Charlie Hale, 2025.08.11

``` {r}
library(tidyverse)
rootDir <- "/workdir/coh22/poaceae_tfbs/"

# Load in counts - note that this doesn't consider motifs that aren't present in any of the triad members
wheat.counts.partial <- read.table(paste0(rootDir, "output/turnover_analysis/paralog_correlation/IWGSC_CS_RefSeq_v2.1_homologCounts.txt"), header = F) %>%
  rename(orthogroup = V2, motif = V1, count = V3) %>%
  separate(orthogroup, into = c("OG", "rank"), sep = "_") %>%
  pivot_wider(names_from = rank, values_from = count, values_fill = 0) %>%
  dplyr::select(c(OG,motif,Rank1,Rank2,Rank3))

all_OGs <- sort(unique(wheat.counts.partial$OG))
all_motifs <- sort(unique(wheat.counts.partial$motif))  
wheat.counts.full <- wheat.counts.partial %>%
  tidyr::complete(
    OG = all_OGs,
    motif = all_motifs,
    fill = list(Rank1 = 0L, Rank2 = 0L, Rank3 = 0L)
  ) %>%
  arrange(OG, motif)

# Calculate correlation
cor_val <- cor(wheat.counts.full$Rank1, wheat.counts.full$Rank3, method = "pearson")
spearman.cor <- cor(wheat.counts.full$Rank1, wheat.counts.full$Rank3, method = "spearman")
ggplot(wheat.counts.full, aes(Rank1, Rank3)) +
  geom_count(aes(color = after_stat(n), fill = after_stat(n)), shape = 21) +
  scale_size_area(max_size = 12, guide = "legend") +
  scale_color_viridis_c(trans = "log", guide = "none") +
  scale_fill_viridis_c(trans = "log", name = "Count") +
  coord_fixed(xlim = c(0,10), ylim = c(0,10)) +
  scale_x_continuous(breaks = 0:10) +
  scale_y_continuous(breaks = 0:10) +
  xlab("Motif count in primary alignment") +
  ylab("Motif count in secondary alignment") +
  theme_minimal() +
  theme(legend.position = "none")

```
